widgetTool.name: show_order_summary
widgetTool.description: Display the current shopping cart as an order summary card, showing the primary product, cost breakdown (subtotal, discount, shipping, tax, total), and confirmation actions.

type.description: REQUIRED. You MUST set this field literally to the string 'order_summary'. Do not omit it.

productItem.description: REQUIRED. Summary of the primary product being purchased.

title.description: REQUIRED. The primary name of the product.

subtitle.description: Product variants like color, storage, or CPU.

price.description: REQUIRED. The unit price of the item.

currencyCode.description: REQUIRED. The three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217 (e.g., 'USD').

units.description: REQUIRED. The whole units of the amount.

nanos.description: Number of nano (10^-9) units of the amount.

costBreakdown.description: REQUIRED. Detailed financial breakdown of the order totals.

currencyCode.description: REQUIRED. The three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217 (e.g., 'USD').

units.description: REQUIRED. The whole units of the amount.

shipping.description: The shipping cost. Set units to 0 for free shipping.
